Sam (Partnerships): Heads-up: we need a compact play for SI onboarding focused on marketplace publishing and certs. Short bullets only.
Rina (SI Enablement): Agreed. Proposal: 3-step path — intro + sales, hands-on deploy lab, cert quiz. Keep total time <3 hours.
Carlos (Marketplace): Marketplace needs a 90s promo, 3 bullet tile, and a 100-word summary. Also require captions.
Sam (Partnerships): Add a preflight form for partners: KMS ARN, infra contact, expected image size. Ship 48h before session.
Onboard Bot: Created TASK-9001 Assign: Carlos, Rina
Rina (SI Enablement): I'll add a micro-lab for publishing to marketplace between deploy and troubleshooting.
Carlos (Marketplace): Will provide tile template and upload it to /files/marketplace-tile.png by EOD.
Sam (Partnerships): Can we add a "verified with coach" intermediate badge? Useful for listing.
Carlos (Marketplace): Yes, need 40x40 icon and copy. Sam can draft copy.
Rina (SI Enablement): Also suggest adaptive quiz: immediate remediation + resubmit window (7 days). Low friction.
Sam (Partnerships): Action items: Sam—badge copy + preflight form fields by Wed (1793520000); Carlos—tile + template by EOD; Rina—micro-lab + adaptive quiz rules by Mon (1793600000).
Onboard Bot: Tasks: TASK-9001, TASK-9002 created.
